description: Phase 5 answer benchmark: 20 questions with manually verified expected answers, scored on the full generated answer (not just retrieval). 'facts' lists what a correct answer must contain; each inner list holds acceptable alternatives. Numbers are compared as numbers, so 4,120 matches 4120. 'expect' is 'answer', 'abstain' (the information is not in any document) or 'conflict' (documents disagree; a correct answer mentions both figures).

questions.question: What was Northwind Robotics' total revenue in fiscal year 2024?
questions.note: Annual report income statement. Trap: the FY2023 column (368.1) sits on the same line.

questions.question: What was Cobalt Harbor Logistics' operating income in fiscal year 2024?
questions.note: Traps: operating expenses (779.2) and operating cash flow (98.5) in the supplement.
